findings.suggested_fix: Set heapReclamationPending_=true under __GLIBC__ after the validated action is inserted into active_ and before prepareAcquisition(), retaining the existing idle/drain gate. This also covers an early cancellation of a prepared native acquisition. Add a first failed/cancelled acquisition regression with no prior successful payload; require one post-drain reclamation and none during active work.
findings.title: Failed or cancelled acquisitions never schedule allocator reclamation
findings.why_it_matters: A first acquisition that allocates native buffers and then fails or is cancelled can drain without requesting the new allocator cleanup. The error branch reaches finish() without enqueue(), while only successful acquisition enqueueing and detached result copying set the pending flag. Marking the accepted action before native preparation covers failed results and early cancellation while preserving the existing idle/drain checks. Retained RSS incidence and magnitude were not measured by this source review.
